caption:
🥗 PANEER TIKKA SALAD
The Salad Edit — Episode 02

360 kcal | 41g protein per serving
Serves 2

This is your sign to eat more salad. 🌱
Spiced, golden paneer tikka, crunchy veggies and the creamiest chaat masala yogurt dressing. A salad that actually feels like a proper meal.

PANEER TIKKA
200g Pride of Cows low-fat high-protein paneer
30g Greek yogurt (I use Milky Mist Skyr)
1 tsp chilli powder
½ tsp coriander powder
½ tsp cumin powder
¼ tsp turmeric
½ tsp garam masala
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tsp lemon juice
Salt

SALAD (helps to volumn eat) 
200g lettuce
150g cucumber
100g capsicum

DRESSING
250g Greek yogurt (I use Milky Mist Skyr)
75g caramelised onion
1 large handful chopped coriander
2 tsp chaat masala
1 tsp peri-peri seasoning
2 tsp lemon juice
Salt + pepper
Water, as needed to thin it out as you see fit 

METHOD
Marinate the paneer with Greek yogurt, spices, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Cook in a hot pan until golden and slightly charred.
For the dressing, whisk together Greek yogurt, caramelised onion, coriander, spices, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Add a little water until creamy and pourable.
Layer the lettuce, cucumber and capsicum. Top with the paneer tikka and drizzle generously with the dressing.

PRO TIP: Make extra dressing. You’ll want it. 🤌🏼

Save this for your next salad & send it to someone who needs to eat more greens. 🥗
